message.content:
Bug #42: The waitlist form in the storefront widget is missing a ZIP code field and the design looks outdated compared to the rest of the widget.

The screenshot shows a waitlist form with:
- "Request delivery to your area" heading
- "Your name" input
- "Your email" input  
- "Submit Request" button

Issues:
1. There is NO ZIP code field — the waitlist form must include the ZIP code so the shop knows which area the customer wants delivery to
2. The design looks outdated and doesn't match the modern style of the rest of the widget sections

Fix requirements:
1. Add a ZIP code input field to the waitlist form (pre-fill it with the ZIP code the user already entered in the checker if available)
2. Make sure the ZIP code is sent to the waitlist API endpoint when submitting
3. Update the design to match the modern style of the rest of the widget (clean inputs, consistent spacing, proper colors from config)

Read ALL widget-related files:
- The main widget JS file(s) in extensions/ directory
- The waitlist API endpoint at app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx
- The widget config to understand available styling options

Then make the fixes. After fixing, run `npm run typecheck` to verify no TypeScript errors.

content.text: No errors. Let me do a final review of the changed sections to confirm correctness:
Everything looks correct. Let me also verify the CSS changes landed cleanly:

All changes are in place and `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors.

Here is a summary of every change made and why:

---

**File changed:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`

**Fix 1 — ZIP code field added to the waitlist form (lines ~818-831)**

The form now has three inputs in order:
- "Your name (optional)" — unchanged in purpose, clarified as optional via placeholder
- "Your email address" — with `aria-label` and `required`
- "ZIP code" — new field, `type="text"`, pre-filled with `escAttr(zip)` (the ZIP the user already entered in the checker), with `aria-label` and `required`

The toggle button text was also updated from the vague "Request delivery to your area" to the clearer "Get notified when we deliver to your area", and the submit button label changed from "Submit Request" to "Notify Me" — both more accurate to what the form actually does.

**Fix 2 — ZIP value is read from the input on submit (lines ~864-877)**

The click handler now reads `wid + "-wl-zip"` from the DOM, normalizes it through the existing `normalizeZip()` helper, and passes `wlZip` to `joinWaitlist()` instead of the closed-over `zip`. If the user edits the ZIP field before submitting (e.g. they typed it wrong), the corrected value is sent. A guard was added: if the ZIP field is empty the ZIP input receives focus instead of submitting.

**Fix 3 — Modern design for the waitlist container and inputs**

- `.zcc-wl` background changed from flat `#f8fafc` to a subtle linear gradient (`#f8fafc` → `#f0f4f8`) and border color harmonized to `#dde3ec`, matching the cooler neutral palette used elsewhere
- `.zcc-wl-input` padding increased slightly (10px → 11px) and font-size bumped to 13.5px to match the result card text; added `line-height:1.4` and `::placeholder` color rule consistent with the main ZIP input
- `.zcc-wl-btn` padding and font-size matched to the input; `margin-top:4px` added to give the button visual breathing room from the last input
- `.zcc-wl-title` upgraded to `display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px` so the inline mail SVG and text sit on one line; added `padding-bottom:10px; border-bottom:1px solid #dde3ec` to create a clean divider between the title and the fields — matching the same divider pattern used by the main widget heading (`.zcc-heading`)
- Added `.zcc-wl-title svg` rule to size and slightly dim the icon (14px, opacity 0.7) for visual hierarchy
